Name: Nyanners Cat Replacer
Author: Kuradjinou
Description:
[size=4]This mod replaces the default cat in Stardew Valley with Nyanners. If you don't know who Nyanners is, she's a very talented and chaotic catgirl VTuber who creates content for [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCO5Jvsc_sKuZi3MhnJxrlzQ]YouTube [/url]and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/nyanners]Twitch[/url].[/size]

[size=4]If you enjoy this mod, you may also like my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45624]Lord Aethelstan Dog Replacer mod[/url].[/size]


[b]Change Log:
[/b]
[list]
[*]Version 1.01 : Changed the mod to replace all three default variations of the cat instead of only the first variation.[/*]
[*]Version 1.10 : Added an outfit for every season. Slightly lightened the pinkness of Nyanners' hair. [i](Also changed the mod to only replace the first variation of the cat again, due to the inclusion of multiple pets now. If you need a version that replaces all the cats, let me know.)[/i][/*]
[/list]

[size=5]﻿[b]INSTALLATION:[/b][/size]
[spoiler][list=1]
[*]Download and install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][b]Content Patcher[/b][/url]﻿ if you haven't already (It will also require [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿).[/*]
[*]Download the mod.[/*]
[*]Unzip the [b]NyannersCat [/b]zip file and place the unzipped folder ([b] [CP] NyannersCat Seasonal[/b] ) into the Mods folder (e.g. C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods)[/*]
[*]Start the game using SMAPI ([i]StardewModdingAPI.exe[/i] in the Stardew Valley folder).[/*]
[*]Play the game![/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

Last functionality test was on Stardew Valley v1.6.15.
If you have any troubles with the mod, leave a comment and I'll try to get back to you when I can.
-Kuradjinou
